verdict.rationale: LobeHub's llms.txt claims each agent has persistent memory that the user can edit and that humans and agents 'co-evolve' over time, which points to durable cross-session memory. That is a single marketing-level line. It describes memory scoped to each agent rather than to the user across all sessions, and it never explicitly says the assistant writes and recalls memories automatically. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic memory writing and recall, user-level memory shared across agents and sessions, dedicated memory docs or settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
